name: deepscientist-lite-academic
description: Optional academic search, reading, writing, review, data, figure, citation, and response workflows for DeepScientist Lite.

interface.shortDescription: Add opt-in academic workflows to DS Lite Core.
interface.longDescription: The optional academic pack contains 17 adapted Nature workflows plus bounded citation, revision, and adversarial-review protocols. It requires DS Lite Core 0.9.0-beta.1, keeps external dependencies workspace-local, and does not silently register MCP servers or credentials.
defaultPrompt: Use the matching nature skill while preserving DS Lite evidence, authorization, and stop gates.
